fourPiece.label: 4 件套暴击伤害
fourPiece.conditionText: 异常掌控大于等于115点时。

fourPiece.label: 4 件套暴击率
fourPiece.conditionText: 队伍中任意角色对敌人施加[冻结]或触发[碎冰]效果时，持续15秒。

fourPieceEffectTexts.en: When Anomaly Mastery exceeds or equals 115 points, the equipper's CRIT DMG increases by 30%. When any squad member applies Freeze or triggers the Shatter effect on an enemy, the equipper's CRIT Rate increases by 12%, lasting 15s.
fourPieceEffectTexts.zh-CN: 异常掌控大于等于115点时，装备者的暴击伤害提升30%；队伍中任意角色对敌人施加[冻结]或触发[碎冰]效果时，装备者的暴击率提升12%，持续15秒。
